mapper.select:
SELECT c.*,d.MONITOR_ENV,d.MONITOR_GROUP,d.DOCKER_SUMMARY,d.IS_ONLINE,d.ID AS dockerId FROM MONITOR_DOCKER_CONTAINER c LEFT JOIN MONITOR_DOCKER d ON c.SERVER_IP = d.SERVER_IP
AND c.SERVER_IP LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.serverIp}, '%')
AND c.CONTAINER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.containerName}, '%')
AND c.IMAGE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.imageName}, '%')
AND c.STATUS LIKE 'Up%'
AND c.STATUS LIKE 'Exited%'
AND d.MONITOR_ENV = #{params.monitorEnv}
AND d.MONITOR_GROUP = #{params.monitorGroup}
